title: 第一卷 正文第7章 灵师一重天第一卷 正文第8章 对战楚江
content_zh:
他继续修炼法门，努力凝聚丹火……
时间如流水，一晃，半个月便过去了。
“滋！”
经过半个月的苦修，楚凌天终于凝聚出一簇小火苗。
虽然这簇小火苗，只有两指宽，忽明忽暗，好似随时都会熄灭一般。但楚凌天总算是踏出了炼丹师的第一步。
他趁热打铁，继续修炼。
又过了去半个月，原本只有两指宽的小火苗，已经变成了拳头大的火焰，散发出炽热的高温，将空气灼烧的啪啪作响。
“可以进行第二步了。”楚凌天自语道。
他将炼丹炉放在身前，将炼丹所需的三株药材，放到一边。
“丹火，起！”
楚凌天低喝一声，双手飞速结印，凝聚出一团丹火，然后指向炼丹炉。
“咻！”
丹火飞射而出，进入炼丹炉内。原本只有拳头大小的丹火，瞬间暴涨，化为熊熊火焰。四周的温度，瞬间拔升了数十度。
楚凌天按照《炼丹师基础》中记录的丹方和炼丹步骤，将身旁的三株药材，逐一投入炼丹炉内。
想要炼制丹药，除了丹火外，还需要有丹方。
对于炼丹师来说，丹方十分珍贵。高品阶的丹方，甚至比强大的功法、武技价值更高。
《炼丹师基础》作为炼丹师的入门手册，其中只记录着三种基础丹方。分别是：一品低阶丹药辟谷丹的丹方、回春丹的丹方，和一品中阶丹药蕴气丹的丹方。
楚凌天现在炼制的，便是难度最低的辟谷丹。
“噗嗤！”
楚凌天将第三种药材刚刚投入炼丹炉，丹火瞬间升腾，将所有药材全部烧为灰烬。

这意味着，楚凌天第一次炼制丹药，宣告失败。
楚凌天脸色平静，并没有感到一丝意外。炼丹本就是个熟能生巧的事情，就像修炼武技一样。从初入到小成到大成，需要时间的沉淀。
他若是第一次炼丹就成功了，那才让他意外呢。
楚凌天深呼吸一口气，略微调整了一下状态，便开始第二次炼制……
炼制辟谷丹所需的三种药材，都是最低级的一品药材，并不难找。楚凌天在风云山脉外围，采集了数千株未成熟的药材或种子，种入宝塔第一层空间。
如今，这些药材都已经成熟，足够他用来练习了。
每一次炼制失败，楚凌天都会总结经验。随着时间的推移，他的炼丹经验越来越丰富。
半个月后，在失败了一百六十六次后，楚凌天终于成功炼制出辟谷丹！
他打开炉盖，从炼丹炉内取出一颗黑色的丹药，正是辟谷丹。
虽然炼制成功了，但这颗辟谷丹的品质并不高，仅仅是下品辟谷丹。
丹药除了有品级划分外，还有品质划分。炼丹师根据丹药的药效、品质，将其划分为四等。分别是：下品、中品、上品、绝品。
绝品丹药可以百分之百的发挥丹药的药效，上品丹药则能发挥出丹药百分之九十的药效，中品丹药能发挥丹药药效的百分之八十，而下品丹药，则只能发挥丹药药效的百分之六十。
绝品丹药与下品丹药之间，足足差着百分之四十的药效差距！
现在的楚凌天，勉强可以算是一品低阶炼丹师了。但想要成为优秀的一品低阶炼丹师，还有很远的路要走。
更别说，他这一次的目标是成为一品中阶炼丹师，炼制蕴气丹。
content_en:
He continued to practice the method and worked hard to condense the elixir fire...
Time is like running water, and half a month has passed in a flash.
"Zi!"
After half a month of hard training, Chu Lingtian finally gathered a small flame.
Although this small flame is only two fingers wide, it flickers on and off, as if it will go out at any time. But Chu Lingtian finally took the first step as an alchemist.
He struck while the iron was hot and continued to practice.
Another half month has passed, and the small flame that was originally only two fingers wide has turned into a flame as big as a fist, emitting blazing high temperature and scorching the air.
"We can proceed to the second step." Chu Lingtian said to himself.
He placed the alchemy furnace in front of him and put aside the three medicinal plants needed for alchemy.
"Elixir fire, start!"
Chu Lingtian shouted low, quickly formed seals with his hands, condensed a ball of alchemy fire, and then pointed at the alchemy furnace.
"Phew!"
The alchemy fire flew out and entered the alchemy furnace. The elixir fire, which was originally only the size of a fist, suddenly surged and turned into a blazing flame. The surrounding temperature instantly rose by dozens of degrees.
Chu Lingtian put the three medicinal plants beside him into the alchemy furnace one by one according to the elixir recipes and alchemy steps recorded in "Basics of Alchemists".
If you want to refine elixirs, in addition to elixir fire, you also need elixir recipes.
For alchemists, pill prescriptions are very precious. High-grade elixir recipes are even more valuable than powerful exercises and martial arts.
"Basics of Alchemists" is an introductory manual for alchemists, and it only records three basic alchemy recipes. They are: the prescription of the first-grade low-grade elixir Bigu Pill, the prescription of the Rejuvenation Pill, and the prescription of the first-grade middle-grade pill Yunqi Dan.
What Chu Lingtian is refining now is the least difficult Bigu Pill.
"Pfft!"
Just as Chu Lingtian put the third medicinal material into the alchemy furnace, the elixir fire instantly rose and burned all the medicinal materials to ashes.
This means that Chu Lingtian's first attempt at refining the elixir failed.
Chu Lingtian's face was calm and he didn't feel the slightest surprise. Refining alchemy is something that practice makes perfect, just like practicing martial arts. From initial entry to small success to great success, it takes time to settle.
It would be a surprise to him if he succeeded in making alchemy for the first time.
Chu Lingtian took a deep breath, adjusted his condition slightly, and then started refining for the second time...
The three medicinal materials needed to refine Bigu Pill are all the lowest first-grade medicinal materials and are not difficult to find. Chu Lingtian collected thousands of immature medicinal herbs or seeds on the outskirts of the Fengyun Mountains and planted them into the first floor of the pagoda.
Now, these medicinal materials are mature enough for him to use for practice.
Every time the refining fails, Chu Lingtian will sum up his experience. As time went by, his alchemy experience became more and more abundant.
Half a month later, after failing one hundred and sixty-six times, Chu Lingtian finally succeeded in refining the Bigu Pill!
He opened the furnace lid and took out a black pill from the alchemy furnace, which was Bigu Pill.
Although the refining was successful, the quality of this Bigu Pill was not high, it was just a low-grade Bigu Pill.
In addition to grade classification, elixirs also have quality classifications. Alchemists classify elixirs into four grades based on their efficacy and quality. They are: low-grade, medium-grade, top-grade, and top-grade.
A top-grade elixir can exert 100% of its efficacy, a top-grade elixir can exert 90% of its efficacy, a middle-grade elixir can exert 80% of its efficacy, and a low-grade elixir can only exert 60% of its efficacy.
There is a full 40% difference in efficacy between top-grade elixirs and low-grade elixirs!
The current Chu Lingtian can barely be regarded as a first-grade low-level alchemist. But there is still a long way to go to become an excellent first-grade low-level alchemist.
Not to mention, his goal this time is to become a first-level intermediate alchemist and refine the Qi Accumulating Pill.
